items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: we do Gaga, I could hear

ctx.x: We did the thing they did with the San Francisco Symphony. So this was a Grammy show or something, and we did some, so I did that. We played for everybody no matter what. Short time rehearsal, sight reading again, you’ve got to be a good sight reader. And all the guys, a lot of the top trumpet players, came, you know, while we’re here, Bobby Shew was here, I’m here, Charlie Davis was here, John Audino for a while. A lot of guys started here and went off into the studios. In fact Chuck Findley and I moved to L.A.…
What about with Lady Gaga now? I mean that must be a high tech show. Are they micing everything in the band?
